title: Area-code shard C pass 22 — 623 / 626 / 629
summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public-person enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 623, 626, and 629.

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 623, 626, and 629?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public-person role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, residence, or public role.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.

findings.notes: Food Not Bombs PHX is current/recent and leaderless. Phoenix Mutual Aid is retained as status-uncertain: a public partner page indicates ongoing quarterly food-run collaboration, but a clearly current first-party home was not recovered. Named FNB volunteers were not promoted to formal org-role person records.

My TRIBE Rise and Matilija Collective are current first-party verified organizations. Heavenly Hughes, Victor Hodgson, Amy J. Wong and Andrew Fung Yip have directly stated public organizational roles.

DRKMTTR Collective and Trans Aid Nashville are current. DRKMTTR first-party programming explicitly includes abolition, mutual aid and solidarity; it is not relabeled anarchist. Olive Scibelli and Kathryn Edwards are retained in directly reported operator roles. TAN provides no named public officer on the first-party page, so no person identity is inferred.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass
